answers.how: At each site, replace Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=P)) with scratch_dir(P), imported from cairn.tools.scratch.scratch, and drop the tempfile import where nothing else uses it: cairn/tools/system_word/proofs/test_a_probe_stub_is_lf_on_every_box.py:52 (tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="cairn-stub-lf-proof-")), landed under 383ac6351996). answers.traces_to: Law 4 (the scratch door is physics, and these lines step around it) and CP6 (what a proof leaves in /tmp accumulates unseen; 3581 dirs did once).
answers.what: Every proof in cairn/tools/system_word takes its temp directory from cairn.tools.scratch.scratch.scratch_dir, so nothing a system_word proof makes outlives its run.
